summary:
Space Relics is an interactive virtual museum dedicated to discovering the human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. From lunar landers and rovers to scientific instruments and mission equipment, explore the fascinating stories behind these space relics.
Navigate planetary landscapes, discover mission artifacts, learn about their purpose and scientific contributions, and interact with an AI-powered museum guide to uncover the history of humanity's journey beyond Earth.
By transforming space exploration history into an engaging and interactive experience, Space Relics helps students, educators, and space enthusiasts understand that every object left behind tells a story of discovery, innovation, and exploration.
details:
Space Relics is an interactive, AI-powered virtual museum that explores the human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions.

The project aims to make space exploration history more accessible, engaging, and educational. Through an interactive planetary exploration experience, users can discover artifacts associated with different missions, explore their purposes, learn about the technologies behind them, and understand their scientific contributions.

The platform also incorporates an AI-powered museum guide that allows visitors to ask questions and learn more about the artifacts and missions they discover. Instead of simply presenting information as text, Space Relics aims to create an engaging learning experience where users can explore space history at their own pace.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

Space Relics helps students, educators, and space enthusiasts understand the history and significance of lunar and Martian exploration. It encourages curiosity about space science, promotes STEM learning, and highlights the scientific achievements behind space missions. It also helps preserve awareness of human exploration by documenting the stories behind objects that remain on other planetary surfaces.

Tools and Technologies Used:

The project was developed using Emergent AI as the AI-assisted development platform. The application uses a React-based frontend, Python with FastAPI for backend development, and MongoDB for data management. The AI-powered guide is integrated using Emergent's managed AI capabilities.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of Space Relics is its virtual museum approach to space exploration. Rather than presenting mission information in a conventional format, it turns the Moon and Mars into interactive spaces where users can discover historical artifacts and learn their stories. The AI museum guide adds an interactive learning dimension, making the experience more conversational and accessible.

Factors Considered During Development:

I considered educational value, accessibility, ease of navigation, accuracy of scientific information, user engagement, and responsive design. Particular importance was given to using reliable NASA-related information and avoiding unsupported claims about artifact locations or mission details.
